title: AI周期若降温：韩国台湾更脆弱，中国多元经济能否更抗冲击？
speaker: Joe

segments.en: I do think this is definitely a double-edged sword, especially the volatility in financial markets recently reminds us that what can drive up domestic demand can be the very same channels that deepen a downturn in the future.
segments.zh: 我确实认为这绝对是双刃剑，尤其是近期金融市场波动提醒我们，推高国内需求的渠道，未来也可能加深下行。

segments.en: So we do think that Korea and Taiwan, because of the strong reliance on this entire AI cycle and exports, make them more vulnerable than in the case with China. And the case with China is already a more diverse economy, it's bigger, so any potential shock will be more manageable.
segments.zh: 我们认为韩国和台湾由于高度依赖整个AI周期和出口，比中国更脆弱。而中国经济更加多元、规模更大，所以任何潜在冲击都更可控。

segments.en: At the same time, because Chinese policymakers haven't really done much in terms of rolling out stimulus, as I mentioned earlier, should there be any potential negative shock, we also think Chinese policymakers will act more proactively and come up with additional policy measures to rescue any potential shock.
segments.zh: 同时，由于中国政策制定者在推出刺激方面尚未大动作，正如我早先提到，如果出现任何潜在负面冲击，我们也认为中国政策制定者会更主动行动，推出额外政策措施来应对潜在冲击。
